founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Self-taught AI builder and seasoned founder. Developed my first webpage at age 8, founded my first company at 17, built a software consultancy generating millions in revenue, exited a product company, launched many failures. Last years spent as engineering leader at startups such as FirstVet, Mindler and Epidemic Sound.
